checkpoint_rule: Select by the arithmetic mean of both domains' tuning NDCG@10; same checkpoint for both audit domains; initial checkpoint remains eligible
primary_comparison: Atoms versus fixed, optimized domain mixing, and ordinary gradient clustering on fixed development audit users, with per-domain results and complete cost accounting
mixture_scope: Atom/cluster proposals preserve exactly 50/50 domain mass and change only within-domain composition; domain_window changes only domain mass
effect_estimation: Each adaptive method queries the same 128 training records per domain per window; bounded importance weights estimate proposed full-data gradients, then current clipped AdamW is simulated. Four domain/fold ranking-margin responses are norm-scaled and their minimum is maximized over a finite candidate menu.
group_scope: One training-only feature pass at the 800-step joint checkpoint. Learned sparse groups and ordinary clusters share the same legal-readout gradient features and nuisance control. Memberships cover the full training pool and remain fixed for this stage.
large_stage_gate: Start only after E005 is complete and both single-domain runs reduce their own-domain tuning loss from initialization. Inspect the E005 tradeoff table at the stage boundary; no requirement to manufacture negative transfer.
evidence_scope: Single-seed development method attempt. Group sketch quality and importance-sampling uncertainty are unproven; no causal interest, universal complementarity, equal wall time, or final-test claim. Random-group and 02-only interventions are a follow-up decision if results justify them.
resource_policy: Only free GPU5/6, finite jobs, release immediately, no idle memory reservation
